offering_description.value: Makes and sells HVAC/R accessories, plumbing and electrical products, architectural building products, and specialty lubricants and chemicals. Customers are mainly contractors, wholesale distributors, OEMs and industrial users. Products are manufactured in-house and sold largely through distribution.

primary_products.value: HVAC/R installation accessories and drain pan products; plumbing and mechanical contractor products; architectural building products such as rooftop supports and railing; specialty lubricants, sealants and chemicals; fire-stopping and electrical products

customer_segment.value: B2B: HVAC, plumbing and electrical contractors, wholesale distributors, OEMs, industrial and energy customers, building owners

end_markets.value: residential and commercial construction; HVAC/R; plumbing; energy; general industrial

revenue_model.value: product sales: HVAC/R, plumbing, building products and specialty chemicals sold to distributors, contractors and OEMs

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures products from purchased materials and components, sold to distributors, contractors and OEMs; brand owner: markets branded products to wholesale distributors and retail channels

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States and Canada, with some sales in Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: diversified: Contractor solutions (HVAC/R, plumbing, electrical), engineered building solutions, and specialty chemicals

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: HVAC, plumbing, electrical and industrial wholesale distributors; third-party retail: home centers and retail stores; direct sales: OEMs, industrial and energy customers
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Chemical manufacturing and product safety rules including EPA, OSHA, and building and fire codes

divestiture_lines: P2.14: through a spin-off from CSWC, with operating companies that are long established names in their respective end markets.
